description: This file defines the `EcuStimulator` class, which is responsible for simulating ECU (Engine Control Unit) behavior, performing measurements, controlling hardware signals, and generating data tables for fuel and timing maps. It contains methods for building calibration tables, setting RPM and voltage levels, and gathering measurement results.

classes.name: EcuStimulator
classes.description: Provides functionality to simulate ECU operation, gather data, and generate calibration tables for fuel and timing maps.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of EcuStimulator.

methods.name: getPanel
methods.description: Returns the main JPanel containing the UI controls for the stimulator.

methods.name: buildTable
methods.description: Builds a calibration table by sweeping through RPM and engine load ranges, measuring dwell and advance, and saving the data as a CSV and C map.

methods.name: createButton
methods.description: Creates a JButton that triggers the stimulation and data collection process when clicked.

methods.name: getInputs
methods.description: Returns the user-configurable inputs controlling the stimulation parameters.

methods.name: waitForMultipleResults
methods.description: Waits asynchronously for a specified number of dwell and advance measurements, returning them as a result object.
